remainingLimitations: No tested real-data recalibrator passed the publication gate. Raw simulation, conditional partial-pooling estimates and empirical historical rates are separately labeled.
Player-stat validation is retrospective and conditional; it is not prospective contract calibration, verified historical executable-price testing or evidence of beating the market.

NFL complete-game compute budget had reached its existing daily guard; it was not increased or reset. This release reuses supported simulation distributions and uses separately labeled historical/statistical evidence where full-game coverage is missing.

Current weather/coaching/opponent effect coefficients are not invented when independent validation is absent. Missing verified availability can withhold research; structural model uncertainty is not fully quantified.

PropLine provides sportsbook references, including DraftKings Sportsbook; an authorized exact DraftKings Predictions feed remains unavailable. After-fee value requires verified fees and settlement terms.
Quote freshness and available players change continuously. Stale prices are withheld from current market comparisons.
General OpenAI chat credential and previously unconfigured Atlas/R2 services were not changed or newly verified in this release.
Physical iPhone installation was not tested. Chromium with an iPhone viewport, HTTPS metadata, actual service-worker registration and offline behavior were tested.

deployment.errorLogScan: No error/fatal runtime logs returned for final deployment during verification.

firstProductionWorkflow.note: Point-in-time source coverage, not model accuracy. The initial browser attempt was corrected to wait for current rather than stale cached results.

finalMobilePatch.checks: typecheck, 10 desktop/mobile browser tests, 6 live workflow checks and 15 live PWA checks passed

productionWorkflow.coverageMeaning: Point-in-time feed and evidence availability, not accuracy, guaranteed future prices or a supported estimate for every player.

preservedInfrastructure.render: Existing PropLine gateway retained without service, tier or credential changes.
preservedInfrastructure.quantitativeService: Existing private Python service on Vercel retained.
preservedInfrastructure.privateData: No financial writes, resets or user-data migration. Personal RLS remains enabled.
